inputs.commit_message: Run fast direct P2P live proof
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
git -C "$root" fetch origin main
git -C "$root" reset --hard origin/main
cd "$root"
npm run local-agent:direct:install
systemctl --user enable --now gova-direct-agent.service
sleep 2
echo '=== SERVICE ==='
systemctl --user is-active gova-direct-agent.service
echo '=== DIRECT STATUS ==='
npx tsx scripts/local-agent-direct-remote.ts status
echo '=== DIRECT EXEC ==='
npx tsx scripts/local-agent-direct-remote.ts exec -- "printf 'P2P_DIRECT_OK\n'; hostname; pwd"
